description: Changes the AI proxy behind neblla.ai.prompt (model, who pays: the developer's key or each user's, per-user token cap) and outgoing webhooks (events Neblla POSTs to an API secret's URL, neblla_set_api_secret). Waits in the draft until neblla_promote "save" (env "pro" for the users). More: neblla_get_llms tools/update_app_integrations

ai.description: { provider (claude, openai, deepseek), model, userTokenMode (off: your key; browser / server: the user's), presets, tokensPerDay, … }, merged; null: AI off.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

webhooks.description: The whole list [{ event (purchase, refund, register, booking…), secret, path? }] (replaces it); null clears it.

name: neblla_update_app_integrations
title: Change AI and webhook settings
